name: Fam
source:
An "E.I." (Emulos Intelligence, pronounced "E-I") in the form of a girl.

　 A girl-type android created by Masaya at "SHE". She calls Masaya, her direct creator, "Dad." As she does not have the same developed intellect and personality as Tierra, she lacks the subtleties of emotion and appears more like a girl who expresses herself and shows her feelings more directly.

　 She was meant to escape with Masaya when he escaped from "SHE", but this did not happen. It is unknown what happened to her after that...?
  "Hey, Dad!
Fam, you did a great job!"
